thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty SEV2 — canary rollout triggered page: CANARY_FAIL_2026.3
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident created <https://pagerduty.com/incidents/P123456|P123456> — pager: @ryan
pd-bridge: Bridge opened: https://pd-bridge/replay/123 — join if available
ryan (oncall): Acked. seeing 95th latency ~1.4s on /v1/generate + 5xx spike. Canary hosts showing memory pressure.
miguel (eng-runtime): Confirming. canary pool: canary-4, image rev: r-infer@2026-03-12-4. Telemetry shows kv-cache evictions and OOM lines on gpu-2.
jen (sre): Autoscaler didn't spin up extra nodes — min_replicas=2, max=5, current=2. Canary traffic weight at 20% for /v1/generate.
alex (support): Several EU customers reporting 502s, ~12 distinct accounts, some realtime streams dropped. Support ticket #9876.
sara (product): Any BYOC clusters impacted? alex: only hosted EU-west-1.
miguel (eng-runtime): Hypothesis: regression in kernel selection with new attention kernel increasing memory per token. Repro: seq_len=1024 workload against canary.
ryan (oncall): Can we rollback the canary to previous stable build immediately?
miguel (eng-runtime): I can abort the canary rollout. Command to run:
```
redwoodctl rollout abort --name canary-2026-03-12-4 --force
```
deploy-bot: Received rollout abort request for canary-2026-03-12-4. Starting rollback.
jen (sre): Routing rule update: reduce canary traffic to 0% and shift to stable-2026-02-28.
pd-bridge: Bridge note: rollback started by miguel. Notifying incident commander.
ryan (oncall): Rolling back now. Monitoring 5xx and latency.
(5m later)
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Canary pool drained. Traffic weight moved: canary 0% -> stable.
jen (sre): Metrics: 5xx rate back to baseline within 90s. Latency P95 down to ~220ms. Monitoring for regressions.
alex (support): Confirming customer reports clearing. Tickets updated: #9876 status -> mitigated.
sara (product): We should mark this a release regression and block further rollouts until root cause identified.
miguel (eng-runtime): Logged INF-4521 with kernel-selector logs + kv-cache dumps. Starting bisect on kernel flags and quantization variant.
ryan (oncall): Handoff: I need to step away. miguel will be primary for follow-ups until 08:00 UTC.
miguel (eng-runtime): Acknowledged. I'll take post-rollback tasks, watch for recurrence, and coordinate a hotfix PR if needed.
jen (sre): Creating postmortem stub. Severity: SEV2. Owners assigned; postmortem due EOD tomorrow.
sara (product): I'll draft customer-facing communication for affected customers and coordinate with support.
incident-bot: Incident P123456 status changed -> mitigated. Postmortem stub: https://confluence.redwood/inci/INF-4521-postmortem
ryan (oncall): Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
miguel (eng-runtime): Will post a timeline and initial bisect results when available.
alex (support): Closing customer tickets as they confirm restored service.
jen (sre): Final note: re-enable canary only after kernel flag tests and memory checks pass in QA.
